focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业须提前布局碳成本核算
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征收阶段。近期欧盟委员会发布过渡期数据申报常见问题指引，强调进口商须确保第三国供应商提供的内嵌碳排放数据可核查。中国钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥等行业对欧出口企业面临碳成本传导压力。建议企业尽快建立产品级碳足迹核算体系，与欧盟进口商明确数据责任划分，并关注欧盟认可的核查机构名单，避免因数据缺失导致默认值惩罚。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会税务与海关同盟总司 · 2026.10.22
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Prepare Carbon Cost Accounting
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with the definitive regime applying from 2027. The European Commission recently issued guidance on common reporting issues, stressing that importers must ensure verifiable embedded emissions data from third-country suppliers. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, cement and fertilisers face carbon cost pass-through pressure. Companies should establish product-level carbon footprint accounting, clarify data responsibilities with EU importers, and monitor the list of accredited verifiers to avoid default-value penalties for missing data.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission, DG Taxation and Customs Union · 2026.10.22

case.title: 新加坡上诉庭确立跨境在线仲裁条款效力认定标准，对中企合同起草具参考价值
case.summary: 新加坡上诉庭近期在一起涉及中国与东南亚企业的供货合同纠纷中，维持了以电子邮件往来达成仲裁协议的效力，明确《新加坡国际仲裁法》下书面形式要求可被电子通信满足。该案凸显跨境交易中仲裁条款的成立不必然依赖单一签署文本，碎片化沟通可能构成有效合意。建议中国出海企业在谈判中明确排除或确认仲裁合意，避免因往来函电产生非预期仲裁管辖，并在合同中统一争议解决条款表述。
case.source: 来源：新加坡上诉庭（Singapore Court of Appeal）· 2026年10月
case.title_en: Singapore Appellate Court Sets Standard for Validity of Cross-Border Online Arbitration Clauses
case.summary_en: The Singapore Court of Appeal recently upheld the validity of an arbitration agreement formed through email exchanges in a supply contract dispute involving Chinese and Southeast Asian companies, confirming that electronic communications can satisfy the writing requirement under the Singapore International Arbitration Act. The case highlights that in cross-border transactions, an arbitration clause need not be contained in a single signed document; fragmented communications may constitute valid consensus. Chinese companies should expressly confirm or exclude arbitration consent during negotiations to avoid unexpected jurisdiction and unify dispute resolution clauses in contracts.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore Court of Appeal · October 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境商事纠纷“一站式”在线调解平台，衔接港澳调解机构
policy.summary: 广东省司法厅与港澳相关机构近期联合推出粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷在线调解平台，整合三地调解资源，为区内企业提供在线申请、调解员选择、协议签署及司法确认对接服务。平台强调调解协议可依《新加坡调解公约》及内地与港澳相关安排申请执行。建议跨境贸易企业将平台调解作为诉讼仲裁前的低成本解决选项，并在合同中约定适用该平台调解的阶梯式争议解决条款。
policy.source: 来源：广东省司法厅、香港律政司、澳门法务局联合发布 · 2026年10月
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches One-Stop Online Mediation Platform for Cross-Border Commercial Disputes
policy.summary_en: The Guangdong Department of Justice, together with Hong Kong and Macao authorities, has launched an online mediation platform for cross-border commercial disputes in the Greater Bay Area. The platform integrates mediation resources across the three jurisdictions, offering online application, mediator selection, agreement signing and judicial confirmation support. It emphasises that mediated settlements may be enforced under the Singapore Convention on Mediation and relevant mainland-Hong Kong/Macao arrangements. Companies are advised to consider platform mediation as a low-cost pre-litigation/arbitration option and to include tiered dispute resolution clauses referencing the platform.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Department of Justice, Hong Kong Department of Justice, Macao Legal Affairs Bureau · October 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中企须重构跨境投融资合规路径
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部近期拟进一步扩大对外投资审查范围，将更多涉及先进计算、量子信息及特定生物技术的对外投资纳入申报要求。中国企业在美设立研发中心、与美资基金共同投资第三国项目均可能触发审查。建议企业立即梳理现有及拟议交易中的美国连接点，评估是否落入禁止或申报类别；在交易文件中设置监管审批先决条件与分手费条款；对涉及敏感技术的合资项目，提前设计股权架构与知识产权隔离方案，并预留6-12个月审批周期。
analysis.source: 来源：美国财政部投资安全办公室、律所实务观察 · 2026年10月
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanded US Outbound Investment Screening Requires Chinese Firms to Rethink Cross-Border Compliance
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Department of the Treasury is reportedly moving to broaden outbound investment screening to cover more investments in advanced computing, quantum information and selected biotechnologies. Chinese companies establishing US R&D centres or co-investing with US funds in third-country projects may trigger scrutiny. Companies should immediately map US nexus in existing and proposed transactions, assess whether deals fall into prohibited or notifiable categories, include regulatory approval conditions and break fees in transaction documents, design equity and IP ring-fencing for sensitive JVs, and budget 6–12 months for approval timelines.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Treasury Office of Investment Security; law firm practice notes · October 2026
